description.en: Egypt, officially the Arab Republic of Egypt, is a country spanning the northeast corner of Africa and southwest corner of Asia via the Sinai Peninsula. It is bordered by the Mediterranean Sea to the north, Palestine and Israel to the northeast, the Red Sea to the east, Sudan and the Sahara to the south, and Libya to the west.
description.zh-CN: 阿拉伯埃及共和國，通稱埃及，是位於北非的國家。地跨亚非两洲，大部分國土位於北非地區，惟西奈半島位於西南亞。
description.zh-TW: 阿拉伯埃及共和國，通稱埃及，是位於北非的國家。地跨亞非兩洲，大部分國土位於北非地區，惟西奈半島位於西南亞。
